--
## Bug Description

When uploading multiple files to the gallery, sometimes not all of them upload — and there's no feedback explaining why. Nothing happens for the skipped files.

## Likely cause

`useUploadQueue.enqueue` filters out anything whose MIME type doesn't start with `image/`, and drops those files with **no feedback**:

```ts
// frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQueue.ts
const enqueue = (files: File[]) => {
  const imageFiles = files.filter((f) => f.type.startsWith("image/"));
  if (imageFiles.length === 0) return;   // ← silent no-op
  ...
};
```

The browser reports an empty or non-`image/*` MIME type for some files (e.g. HEIC/HEIF, or certain drag-and-drop / OS combinations), so they're silently discarded and never enter the queue — hence "it just does nothing." `MemberPhotos.handleFileChange` has the same silent `image/*` filter.

## Expected Behavior

- Files skipped because they aren't recognised as images produce a visible message (toast, or a "skipped/unsupported" row in the upload queue) naming how many and why.
- Reconsider the detection: fall back to extension when the MIME type is empty, so common image files aren't wrongly rejected.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Uploading a mix of supported and unsupported/undetected files always reports what happened to each
- [ ] Files with an empty MIME type but a valid image extension are accepted (or at least clearly reported, not silently dropped)
- [ ] Same handling applied to the member-sheet photo upload path

## Relevant Files

- `frontend/src/hooks/useUploadQueue.ts`
- `frontend/src/components/view/gallery-view/UploadImageCard.tsx`
- `frontend/src/components/shared/member-sheet/MemberPhotos.tsx`

fix(documents): stop document uploads from silently stalling mid-batch

Staging files for a member-sheet document was a single unguarded sequential
loop with no per-file error isolation and no request timeout, so one stalled

failed upload names the offending file(s) instead of silently dropping them.

Fixes #773
